text:
oliver: Deploybot raised an auto-revert for rolling v5.1.0 canary in us-east. p95 and 5xxs spiked. change window ~45m left. auto recommend revert. Thoughts? :thinking:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Canary checks: p95=2100ms (thr 1300ms), 5xx_rate=0.9% (thr 0.2%). Suggest: `/deploy revert --auto v5.0.7`
mona: i'm seeing a routing config mismatch plus a small heap pressure bump after the new allocator. If we auto-revert we lose live traces. prefer manual to snapshot and coordinate comms.
oliver: agree manual. ops-run can flip the safety latch to prevent auto actions. plan: 1) disable auto-revert 2) pin routing to v5.0.7 3) collect traces & heap dumps 4) route back 20% for 7m 5) full cutover if stable, else manual revert.
ops-run: disabling auto-revert now (lock L-58123). Will not perform actions without explicit `/deploy revert` from lead.
infra-qa: i'll trigger profiler: `./scripts/profiler collect --app canary --dur 30s -o /tmp/prof-5812345670.tar.gz` and capture heap: `gcore <pid>`
mona: note: please capture router logs with `rg "alloc" /var/log/router/*.log` and upload artifacts to gs://redwood-traces/5812345670/
acctmgt: flagging two customers on us-east who saw degraded responses. i'll DM and prep a short blurb if we rollback.
oliver: ops-run, apply routing pin TTL=90m and reply with lock id. then start 20% slice. i'll watch metrics and give go/no-go.
ops-run: applied pin lock id pin-77, TTL=90m. 20% slice applied at 5812345680. monitoring.
infra-qa: at 20% slice p95=1.15s, 5xx=0.12%. traces uploaded: gs://redwood-traces/5812345670/prof.tgz. heap dump at gs://redwood-traces/5812345670/heap.dump
mona: looks good. allocate team will investigate allocator change. if stable after 7m proceed to 100% then remove pin. oliver will send customer note drafted by acctmgt.
acctmgt: draft: "We observed elevated latency in the canary for v5.1.0 and are rolling back to v5.0.7 while we investigate an allocator change. No downtime expected; we'll follow up with findings." Posting to #customer-comms now.
oliver: approve cutover after 7m stable. proceed to 100% and unpin. ops-run, execute when ready.
ops-run: promoting to 100% at 5812345703, removed pin, autoscaler resumed. cutover complete.
infra-qa: post-cut p95=0.75s, 5xx=0.02%. artifacts retained and PM created PM-5812345 for allocator perf regression.
oliver: thanks team. sales notified, postmortem on PM-5812345. closing thread once PM is published. :white_check_mark:
